context.scope: Bench assembly and acceptance screening of a generic sensor module; process FMEA
assumptions: Items are listed in process order
No measured process capability or defect rates
requirement_refs: P2: retain the electrical connection mechanically
P3: identify modules passing the prescribed functional screen

items.name: Select components
items.function: Select the specified sensor and harness

items.name: Install connector
items.function: Seat and latch the electrical connector

items.name: Fasten module
items.function: Secure the module with the specified fasteners

items.name: Label and release
items.function: Identify and release modules that passed screening

description: The manual process is performed in this order: select the sensor and harness from labeled bins using a work instruction; seat the connector until its latch engages; install module fasteners using a torque driver; connect the module to a bench fixture and run a functional screen; apply a serial label and release the module if the operator records a passing result. The torque driver and screen are stated process tools, but current calibration status, torque values, test coverage, fixture diagnostics, independent inspection, measured defect rates and interlocks are not supplied. The screen measures electrical response only; do not assume it verifies every mechanical or configuration requirement. Analyze process errors and consequences for the assembled module and downstream user. Proposed inspections must remain proposed actions, not asserted existing controls.
